title: Mildred Bailey and the hard modulations
summary: He wrote difficult modulations that Mildred sang flawlessly.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: When Red did his oral history interview, he told one story that I'll have to tell you because it concerns you.
Red said that one day that for some reason Mildred had done something that annoyed you--
I know what you're going to say.
--so you wrote a really hard modulation in one of the charts and she just went through it flawlessly.
Do you remember which chart that was?
There were a couple of them.
This was more than a one time occurrence?
That's true. I think "Smoke Dreams" might have been one of them, but that was a little
early on, and another one was a Gershwin tune. I remember the incident; but she didn't miss a beat piece.
